name: Zen Mesh — Webhook Operations Wedge Claim Map
product: Zen Mesh (Webhook Operations — Stripe, GitHub, Custom)
overall_readiness: Sandbox/local validation. Free and Pro plans are buyer-facing. Production-live cloud deployment is tracked separately.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh ingests Stripe webhook events via a dedicated endpoint with signature verification
claims.limitation: Signature verification tested in mock scenarios only. Production Stripe key validation pending.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh provides a GitHub webhook adapter for ingestion
claims.limitation: GitHub provider adapter exists in architecture. Webhook-specific signature validation and end-to-end testing not yet performed.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh supports custom webhook ingestion via a generic pipeline
claims.limitation: Generic ingestion pipeline is designed. Provider-specific handling requires per-adapter configuration. Not yet validated.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh records delivery attempts and outcomes for webhook events
claims.limitation: Delivery attempt struct is in-memory only. Persistence and customer-facing visibility are separate.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh retries failed webhook deliveries with configurable exhaustion routing to DLQ
claims.limitation: DLQ behavior tested in local mock only. Customer-facing DLQ retry UI is separate.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh detects and handles duplicate webhook events via idempotency keys
claims.limitation: Idempotency tested in mock only. Provider-native idempotency interop not yet validated per source.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh enforces mTLS on internal paths for webhook delivery
claims.limitation: mTLS enforced on internal control-plane paths. Not all data-plane paths have mTLS yet.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh verifies HMAC-signed webhook payloads with nonce-based replay protection
claims.limitation: HMAC verification tested in mock scenarios. Provider-specific webhook signing integration per source.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh provides machine-readable evidence of webhook delivery with Merkle integrity verification
claims.limitation: Merkle provides evidence integrity only — not delivery confirmation, ordering, or identity verification.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh uses SPIFFE/SPIRE identity for workload authentication on internal paths
claims.limitation: SPIFFE identity scoped to internal paths. SVID rotation is not yet automated.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh has internal control mappings to PCI-DSS, SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-53, and HIPAA Security Rule
claims.limitation: Control mappings are internal readiness only. No certification, audit, or attestation has been performed.

claims.claim: Zen Mesh provides UI visibility into webhook route configuration and delivery status
claims.limitation: Route configuration UI exists. Comprehensive delivery status dashboard is planned. Rendered browser validation not yet performed.

claims.claim: Modular provider adapter model supports Stripe, GitHub, Twilio, Shopify, and Custom sources
claims.limitation: Provider expansion is roadmap/planned. Not validated. Not production support. Adapter model is architectural design, not marketplace coverage.

claims.claim: Webhook end-to-end path validated with real provider events on a cloud deployment
claims.limitation: All webhook testing is local/mock only. Real provider event validation on a cloud deployment is pending.

claims.claim: Webhook operations wedge is customer-ready for production use
claims.limitation: Current readiness is DEMO level. Not customer-ready or production-live.
